stemMd: A solution is made by dissolving 6 g solute in 94 g water. What is the solute mass percentage?
explanationMd: Total solution mass is 6 + 94 = 100 g. Mass percentage is solute mass divided by total solution mass, multiplied by 100, giving 6%. Always distinguish the mass of solution from the mass of solvent.

distractorRationale.c: This divides by solvent mass rather than total solution mass.
distractorRationale.e: This is the solvent mass percentage.
distractorRationale.a: This fails to convert the mass fraction to percent.
distractorRationale.d: This inverts an unrelated ratio of solvent to solute.
